The '''T9 Stinger''' was a model of boarding tube produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It included high-power [[Plasma torch/Legends|plasma torch]] to cut a hole in a docked craft's [[Hull/Legends|hull]] or [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]].<ref name="DC" />
